cues: In the Nernst equation, log of one over hydrogen ion squared is two p H.
So E equals zero point seven six minus zero point zero five nine one times p H. Solve: zero point one seven seven three over zero point zero five nine one, p H three.
That is exactly how a p H meter works, with glass and calomel electrodes.
